summary_md: **Qwen AI Fans ([@QwenAIFans](https://x.com/QwenAIFans/status/2116095612454359047))** reports that **QEngine**, a source-available C++/CUDA engine for Qwen3.8-27B INT4 on three RTX 3090s, cuts 200K-context time-to-first-token from about 130 s (dual-card vLLM) to about 51 s with 2.2–2.8× single-user output speed, while noting the GPU counts differ so readers should re-test ([bpx03/QEngine](https://github.com/bpx03/QEngine)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - bpx03/QEngine: Source-available C++/CUDA inference engine for Qwen3.8-27B INT4 on 3x RTX 3090

relevance: Long-context performance for a ~27B model on consumer GPUs.

media.description: QEngine v1.0 vs vLLM 0.28 summary cards: 2.6× faster 200K prefill, 2.2–2.8× single-user speed, 1.2–2.0× throughput, 100% chat SLA.
